title: Big Candle
body:
"A dyeable candle that's nice and thicc! Perfect for adding atmosphere."

Description

The Big Candle is part of the candle series of items sold at the Monstrous Manor for the 2025 Halloween event. It can be bought at the Monstrous Manor or from Halloween Poppers. Its more fatter in width and more cylindrical than the other candles.

Trivia

  • This item (like all the other candles) can be dyed.
  • When interacted with, it can be lit up with [f] [image needed]
  • Candles can be placed in candle holder or fancy candle holders
